title: Gamma Function
subtitle: Special Functions · Factorial extension
summary: Extension of the factorial to complex numbers: Γ(n+1) = n!
detail:
\[ \Gamma(z) = \int_0^{\infty} t^{z-1}e^{-t}\,dt \]

Meromorphic on \(\mathbb{C}\) with poles at non-positive integers. Key properties: \(\Gamma(z+1)=z\Gamma(z)\); \(\Gamma(1/2)=\sqrt{\pi}\); reflection formula \(\Gamma(z)\Gamma(1-z)=\pi/\sin(\pi z)\). Implemented via the Lanczos approximation.
